contexts_with_sources: [P:053 | COQUETRY] This fragile beauty is made the emblem of coquetry, because its flowers seldom last a second day. || [T:346 | Coquetry] Yellow day-lily flowers rarely remain open for two days, giving rise to the French name belle d’un jour (pp. 71–72).
